settings.question: How long until I see results?
settings.answer: You’ll feel the difference the moment you put it on — shoulders back, spine aligned. With consistent wear (about 30 minutes a day), most customers notice their natural posture improving within a few weeks as muscle memory builds.

settings.question: Will it fit me?
settings.answer: Yes — the straps are fully adjustable and it comes in sizes S to XXXL, so you can pick the perfect fit for your body type.

settings.question: Can I wear it under clothes?
settings.answer: Absolutely. The slim, breathable design is virtually invisible under a shirt or blouse, so you can wear it at the office, while commuting, or at home.

settings.question: How long should I wear it each day?
settings.answer: Start with 20–30 minutes a day and increase gradually as it feels comfortable. It’s designed to gently remind your muscles of correct alignment — not to do all the work forever.

settings.question: How fast is shipping?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 24 hours and arrive with free tracked shipping. You’ll receive your tracking number by email as soon as it’s on the way.

settings.question: What if it doesn’t work for me?
settings.answer: You’re covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee. If you’re not happy for any reason, contact support and we’ll refund you in full.
